<a name="FileRegistrationStore"></a>
## type [FileRegistrationStore](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/store.go#L74>)

FileRegistrationStore uses a POSIX owner\-only directory on a local filesystem supporting atomic rename and file/directory fsync. An interrupted process leaves .lock: remove it only after confirming no process uses this directory. Back up the whole directory, including operational\-key.json. Container\-local storage is not durable across host replacement. Do not modify files manually.

```go
type FileRegistrationStore struct{ Directory string }
```

<a name="RegisterManagedIdentity"></a>
### func [RegisterManagedIdentity](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/registration.go#L81>)

```go
func RegisterManagedIdentity(ctx context.Context, name string, loaded config.Loaded, credential string, store ManagedRegistrationStore, input *dnsid.AgentRegistrationInput, options ...Options) (result *ManagedRegistrationResult, err error)
```

RegisterManagedIdentity creates or resumes one durable managed setup. The default total budget is ten minutes. The registry must support permanent keyed creation; verify that server contract before enabling automatic recovery.

## type [ManagedRegistrationStore](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/store.go#L48-L50>)

ManagedRegistrationStore acquires exclusive access from load through return. A database implementation must retain the same key locator across restarts.

```go
type ManagedRegistrationStore interface {
    Acquire(context.Context, Scope) (Session, error)
}
```

<a name="Options"></a>
## type [Options](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/registration.go#L43-L50>)

Options supplies optional runtime dependencies. An injected RegistryClient owns its credentials and networking. Otherwise setup builds the SDK client from the explicit credential and effective transport configuration. Injected log trust and providers require stable references on resume.

```go
type Options struct {
    RegistryClient    RegistryClient
    Dependencies      config.Dependencies
    TrustReference    string
    ProviderReference string
    PollInterval      time.Duration
    Timeout           time.Duration
}
```

<a name="RegistryClient"></a>
## type [RegistryClient](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/registration.go#L32-L37>)

RegistryClient is the existing registry surface used by managed setup. Keyed creation must implement permanent organization\-scoped idempotency, derived\-key validation, and atomic name/key ownership. The SDK HTTP client implements this interface; consumers do not need a recovery adapter.

```go
type RegistryClient interface {
    dnsid.RegistryPreparedEventClient
    dnsid.RegistryRegistrationReader
    RegisterAgent(context.Context, *dnsid.AgentRegistrationInput, string) (*dnsid.AgentRegistration, error)
    GetOrganizationOnboarding(context.Context) (*dnsid.OrganizationOnboardingResponse, error)
}
```

<a name="Scope"></a>
## type [Scope](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/replay.go#L16-L20>)

Scope isolates a named operation within an authenticated registry account. Stores must persist and verify this tuple, never use raw names as paths.

```go
type Scope struct {
    RegistryURL    string
    OrganizationID string
    Name           string
}
```

<a name="Session"></a>
## type [Session](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/store.go#L54-L59>)

Session owns a locked setup operation. RecoverKey must durably rediscover the same key. create is true only for the first key attempt after intent is saved.

```go
type Session interface {
    Load(context.Context) (*State, error)
    Save(context.Context, *State) error
    RecoverKey(context.Context, bool) (dnsid.KeyProvider, error)
    Close() error
}
```

<a name="State"></a>
## type [State](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/registration/store.go#L23-L44>)

State is public recovery data. Credentials and private keys must never be written here. Stores must atomically persist the complete state.

```go
type State struct {
    Version int
    Loaded  config.Loaded
    Scope
    Input                        *dnsid.AgentRegistrationInput
    CreationFingerprint          string
    KeyStarted                   bool
    KeyLocator                   string
    ProviderReference            string
    LogTrustReference            string
    OperationalKey               json.RawMessage `json:"operationalKey,omitempty"`
    Creation                     *dnsid.CreateAgentResponse
    Registration                 *dnsid.AgentRegistration
    EntityKey                    json.RawMessage `json:"entityKey,omitempty"`
    EntityThumbprint             string
    CurrentOperationalThumbprint string
    Issuance                     *c2sptlog.ManagedIssuanceState
    IssuanceCompacted            bool
    Phase                        string
    Complete                     bool
    ObservedRegistryStatus       string
}
```
